topic: Day 25 — carousel — Love isn't proof of compatibility, it's proof of attachment

slides.text: It's proof of attachment. Those are different things.
Strong feeling gets treated as evidence of rightness.
But attachment can exist in things that don't work.
Feeling it isn't the same as [fitting].

caption:
Emotional intensity gets treated as evidence of rightness, when it's really just evidence of attachment. Those aren't the same thing.
